title: Terra Major Update is live — New Faction Bases, rivals with memory, and 30 pink relics nobody asked for
author: Rhuneark
selftext:
[https://w.run/rhuneark/classification-terra](https://w.run/rhuneark/classification-terra)

Terra just got a big update. Here's a showcase video.

**🏚️ Faction Base is a real system now.** Weight Class, live Morale, 5 upgrade tracks (Walls, Watchtower, Depot, Barracks, Clinic). Let it rot and survivors actually leave.

**😤 Rivals remember you.** Grudge climbs 5 levels the more you hit them — harder, angrier, more rewarding. Push one to Level 5 and you might recruit them instead of beating them.

**🎀 30 flamingo-pink Nostalgic Relics.** Broken → Perfect, 4 completable sets, a new Relic Room to trophy them in. First Perfect relic in the world = your name in the global feed.

**🆕 Tons of new items**, a global Paperclip count on the Explorer Board, and the Field Codex now tracks species progress.
